MDR1-MDCKII permeability assay is performed using MDCK-MDR1 cells, cultured for 4 days to form a monolayer on 24-well PET inserts. Integrity of monolayer confirmed with TEER > 350 Ohm cm2 (before assay) and lucifer yellow < 1 x10-6 cm.s-1 (after assay). The compounds are incubated at 10 uM for 2 hours at 37 C, volumes used are 0.4 mL in the apical and 0.8 mL in the basolateral. Test compound is added to apical well and transport determined by measuring concentration in basolateral well at 2 hours (A to B). At the same time as A to B incubation, a parallel incubation is also performed where test compound is added to a basolateral well and then measured in the apical well (B to A) at 2 hours. The efflux ratio is then calculated by comparing the rates of transport in both directions to determine if test compound is an efflux transporter substrate. Further parallel incubations performed using Cyclosporin A as P-gp inhibitor that is co-incubated with test compound to confirm if the transporters are involved. All donor wells contain lucifer yellow. The final solvent concentration is 0.1 % DMSO. After the 2 hours incubation, aliquots are removed from all apical and basolateral wells for analysis by LC-MS/MS with internal standard against a standard curve. Response ratio is compared with the standard curve to determine the concentrations in receiver and donor wells and calculate the apparent permeability. The percentage of recovery is calculated to indicate non-specific binding of the test compound. The assay has been performed by Concept Life Sciences Ltd.
